## Tillwise 2.3.0: a POS for any kind of business

Spice Shop POS is now **Tillwise**, with a new logo. Existing tills upgrade in place and keep their
data, including sales still waiting to upload.

### Built for your kind of business
- Choose your **type of business** (clothing, grocery, pharmacy, hardware, restaurant, bakery, beauty,
  electronics, books, services, wholesale, manufacturing and more) at registration or in the new
  **Settings** page. It sets sensible features, units and wording; switch any feature on or off.
- **Variants:** sizes, colours or styles. List the values, press **Generate**, and every combination
  gets its own price, opening stock and barcode. Scanning a variant's barcode adds exactly that one;
  tapping the product opens a picker with size and colour chips.
- **Sell by measure:** a price per kg, litre or metre, and the till asks for the amount (2.5 m, 0.75 kg).
- **Units:** piece, pair, box, pack, dozen, kg, g, litre, ml, metre, hour and more.
- **Services:** items with no stock, such as a haircut or a repair.
- **Batches and expiry dates** on deliveries. The first batch to expire is sold first, and Products
  warns about anything expiring within 30 days.
- Shops that don't use bottles or production no longer see them on the till or in the menu.

### Your colours
- Pick an accent colour and a background tone in **Settings**. It previews live and applies to every
  till and screen in the shop. Text stays readable whatever you pick. Light or dark is still chosen
  per device.

### Fixes
- Amounts now show your shop's currency instead of always "LKR".
- Saving a barcode that another product already uses is refused, instead of silently breaking that
  product's scan.
- Product tile colours chosen in the dashboard now show on the till.
- Pack sizes and variants can have their own barcode, and editing a product shows its barcode.
- An owner with two shops always gets the right shop's settings on the till.

### Before you update
Run `supabase/migrations/0030_business_types.sql` (after 0028 and 0029) on your Supabase project.
Existing shops keep every feature they had until the owner picks a business type in Settings.
